units.source_text: 名人的遗体当天运回了东京。

en.t: The Master's remains were taken back to Tokyo that same day.

units.source_text: 从旅馆正门运上汽车的时候，用棉被裹得很小很小，简直像没有尸体一般。

en.t: When they carried him out through the front entrance of the inn and into the car, he was wrapped so small in a cotton quilt that it almost seemed there was no body there at all.

units.source_text: 我们站在稍远的地方，等待着汽车出发。

en.t: We stood a little way off, waiting for the car to depart.
